Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

servers.description: Hosting servers the VTA is registered with. Carries no credentials — what the VTA holds to authenticate against a server never appears in a response.

Response.title: VTA WebVH Servers List — response payload

WebvhServerRecord.description: A hosting server the VTA is registered with. Carries no credential: what the VTA holds to authenticate against the server is never part of this record and never leaves it.

did.description: The server's own DID, used to authenticate it.

id.description: Local id for the server, chosen by the operator.
